description: Election Commission - Nominated  Kanapathy Kulandevel  Ravi as Chairam of the Norwood
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in the office of Chairman of a local authority (Norwood Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the nomination and declaration of an elected official following a resignation. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and election-related declarations.
